summary: A Details button in the desktop chat header (and Cmd+Shift+B for the focused chat) opens a popover with the chat's machine (This Mac, or the host and SSH), branch (git:current-branch), the first open linked pull request (else the newest) with its checks, the working-tree lines added and removed against HEAD (new git:diff-stat channel, git diff --numstat HEAD), an Open in editor action that shows the embedded IDE pane, and three bars: the account's weekly and 5-hour limits (the provider usage store, read unforced on open, so main's 45 s cache applies as for Settings > Accounts) and the chat's context use (the composer's context ring value). Bars show the percent left and turn amber at 20 % left or less and red at 10 % or less; a limit that cannot be read shows Unavailable. Cmd+Shift+B moves from the sidebar toggle (Cmd+B stays) to this popover. New text tokens --text-success, --text-warning and --text-error keep coloured text at 4.5:1 on the popover surface in light and dark.

reactNativeIos.followUpRelease: mobile-v0.6.0: a Details sheet from the chat header with the same rows, reading git:current-branch, git:diff-stat, the chat's PR links and the usage read the phone already makes. Nothing changes on the phone in this release.

nativeAndroid.followUpRelease: Native Android 0.6.0: a Details sheet from the chat header with the same rows and the same reads as iOS. Nothing changes on the phone in this release.

storageDataMigration.reason: The popover reads live state (git, PR links, usage readings, the session's token usage) and stores nothing. A user's saved shortcut overrides keep working: an override of the sidebar toggle replaces its bindings as before.

automated: tests/unit/chat-details-model.test.ts: Machine labels for a local and a remote chat, Open in editor on a host, branch and detached HEAD and None, the first open PR with failing checks marked bad and a merged PR, No changes at zero, usage bars with tones, Unavailable and pending bars, and the closed Details button markup.
tests/unit/usage-left.test.ts: percent left with clamping and rounding, tone boundaries at 10, 11, 20 and 21, and null.
tests/unit/git-refs.test.ts: numstat totals with a binary file, and the git diff --numstat HEAD call.
tests/unit/raised-surface-contrast.test.ts: --text-success, --text-warning and --text-error read at 4.5:1 or better on --bg-elevated in dark and light.
